public_rationale: Marcus says the reports 'seem reasonably often' to contain subtle errors. This is a hedged impression with no defined frequency or detection standard. Turning it into a scored frequency claim would strengthen his words. Independent testing can assess particular errors, but cannot fairly settle this sentence as written.
limitations: This decision does not establish that Deep Search reports were accurate or inaccurate.
The contextual review covers a different sample and does not measure how difficult errors were to detect.
